* '''PC-E1''' ([[Tatooine: Dune Sea (V) (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 24 release sheet<ref name="sheet24-20250202">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-24.pdf Virtual Set 24 release sheet] (PDF, 3 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, December 2024”; file created 2 February 2025). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
